# 暑期暂停期间提升业务的 SEO 套餐

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2025-06-27 00:45（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/1938277427198706044
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

18 年前，我刚到欧洲时，完全不理解“暑期暂停”。

我会花上几周发邮件，结果 90% 的邮件都只收到了“休假中”的自动回复。

你知道，就是这种：

“谢谢来信。

接下来的 4 周，我将休年假。

回到办公室后，我会回复你。”

这些回复让我很生气。

那时我还年轻，心态里充满匮乏感。我以为，只要不工作，就会失去发展势头，或者收入，或者两者都失去。

后来我才意识到，夏天并不需要那么拼命。逆着大家的节奏硬干，实在很荒谬。

于是，我决定开始利用暑期暂停，改善自己的业务。

每次这样做之后，业务都会变得好很多。

比如，我的 SEO 代理机构已经满负荷运转了；这意味着我上一次暂停达到了预期。现在，我要奖励自己一个暑期暂停，去旅行。

我会在葡萄牙和西班牙自驾，拜访家人和朋友，同时阅读、学习、思考如何进一步改善业务。

不过，如果你准备认真对待 SEO，让免费流量自动持续到来，我仍然可以帮助你。

购买“暑期暂停助推套餐（The Summer Pause Boost）”，这样你也能建立一家在你想暂停时仍可运转的业务。

## 英文原文

When I first came to Europe 18 years ago, I didn't understand "The Summer Pause".

I would spend weeks sending emails just to get a "vacation" autoresponder to 90% of my emails.

You know the ones:

"Thank you for writing.

I'm on my annual leave for the next 4 weeks.

I'll get back to you once I'm back in my office."

I was angry at these responses.

Back then I was young and coming from a place of scarcity. If I wasn’t working, I thought I’d lose momentum. Or income. Or both.

Until I realized I didn’t need to hustle so hard during summer. It was absurd to go against the current.

So, I decided I'd start taking The Summer Pause to improve my businesses.

And every time I did, they became A LOT better. 

As an example, my SEO agency is at full capacity; that means my last paused went as planned. And I'm rewarding myself with The Summer Pause to travel.

Portugal and Spain will be the scenario of a roadtrip to meet family and friends while I read, study and think on how to improve my business further.

Get The Summer Pause Boost so that you can, too, create a business that operates when you want to pause.
